title: Convergence rate of the occupation measure of classes of ergodic processes toward their invariant distribution in mean Wasserstein distance
summary: N. Fournier and A. Guillin obtained in their 2015 PTRF paper some bounds of the L^p-mean rate of convergence in Wasserstein distance of empirical distributions for a class of stationary mixing processes. In this paper, we propose to extend their strategy of proof and provide general criterions which allow to keep similar rates for a larger class of processes.
